observed.reading_this_file: Field paths use $ for the record root and [] for an array, so one path covers every element. populated_on counts sampled records in which the path held a non-empty value; present_empty_on counts records where the key was there but null or empty. populated_on_labels and absent_on_labels name which samples, which is what a present-but-unreliable row needs to state its condition (requirements.md D5).
observed.verdict_rule: This file is the only admissible basis for a verdict in specs/paypal-fields.md (requirements.md D1). A field declared by the SDK but with populated_on 0 here is absent.
